You see the load-bearing myths and put your shoulder to them.

Level 3: OP Shear (BBTTCC)

When a structure/vehicle fails a check you influence, your faction may convert 1 Economy OP → 1 Violence OP (once/round).

Level 3: Find the Fault

Bonus action mark: the next allied attack against a chosen object/barricade deals +PB damage.

Level 6: Controlled Collapse

Redirect debris to avoid collateral; if civilians would have been harmed, reduce regional Darkness −1 (1/long rest).

Level 10: Breach Rhythm

After you damage a fortification, allies within 10 ft gain +2 AC vs. ranged attacks from that direction until your next turn.

Level 14: Pancake the Span

Once per siege round, set the DC of one allied breach action to 10 + PB (before rolling).
